cover_headline: Cabinet Clears 78-Day Diwali Bonus for 11.4 Lakh Railway Employees
facts: The bonus equal to 78 days' wages covers about 11,40,770 non-gazetted railway employees at a total cost of Rs 2,009.61 crore
Each eligible employee will receive up to Rs 17,951, set by a notional salary ceiling of Rs 7,000 a month
Indian Railways loaded 1,670 million tonnes of freight and carried nearly 7.41 billion passengers in 2025-26

quote.text: This bonus is a Diwali gift for the hardworking railway employees who work tirelessly day and night.
quote.speaker: Ashwini Vaishnaw

end.headline: Cabinet Clears 78-Day Diwali Bonus for 11.4 Lakh Railway Employees
end.line: The Rs 2,009.61 crore Productivity Linked Bonus pays up to Rs 17,951 per eligible employee ahead of the festival season.
